```{r init}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library('lme4'))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library('MASS'))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library('glmmTMB')) # For the Unstructured model fit
```

```{r cov_funcs}
# Functions to generate the 4 covariances of interest
gen_ind_cov <- function(pars) {
    n <- pars$n_trt * pars$n_blk * pars$n_rep
    diag(rep(pars$s2e, n))
}
gen_comp_symm_cov <- function(pars) {
    # Initial n_rep x n_rep block matrix with just s2b
    unit_cov <- matrix(pars$s2b, nrow = pars$n_rep, ncol = pars$n_rep)
    # Add s2e to the diagonals of the block matrix
    unit_cov <- unit_cov + diag(rep(pars$s2e, pars$n_rep))
    kronecker(diag(pars$n_trt * pars$n_blk), unit_cov)
}
gen_ar1_cov <- function(pars) {
    times <- 1:pars$n_rep
    unit_cov <- pars$s2e * (pars$rho^abs(outer(times, times, "-")))
    kronecker(diag(pars$n_trt * pars$n_blk), unit_cov)
}
gen_unstr_cov <- function(pars) {
    kronecker(diag(pars$n_trt * pars$n_blk), pars$unstr_cov)
}
gen_all_cov <- function(pars) {
    # list(
    #     Independent = gen_ind_cov(pars), 
    #     CompoundSymmetric = gen_comp_symm_cov(pars), 
    #     AR1 = gen_ar1_cov(pars), 
    #     Unstructured = gen_unstr_cov(pars))
    list(
        Independent = gen_ind_cov(pars), 
        CompoundSymmetric = gen_comp_symm_cov(pars), 
        AR1 = gen_ar1_cov(pars))
}
```

```{r sim_funcs}
gen_data <- function(pars, trt_means, Sigma) {
    block <- unlist(lapply(1:(pars$n_trt*pars$n_blk), 
        \(x) rep(x, times = pars$n_rep)))
    reps <- rep(1:5, pars$n_trt*pars$n_blk)
    means <- unlist(lapply(trt_means, 
        \(x) rep(x, times = pars$n_blk*pars$n_rep)))
    errors <- mvrnorm(n = 1, 
        mu = rep(0, pars$n_trt*pars$n_blk*pars$n_rep), Sigma = Sigma)
    dt <- data.frame(
        Treatment = means, 
        Block = as.factor(block),
        Repetition = as.factor(reps),
        Response = means + errors)
}

pick_best_model_fit <- function(dt, cov_list) {
  # 1. Independent OLS Model
  mod_ind <- lm(Response ~ Treatment + Block, data = dt)
  bic_ind <- BIC(mod_ind)
  
  # 2. Compound Symmetry Model (via glmmTMB)
  bic_cs <- tryCatch({
    mod_comp_symm <- glmmTMB(Response ~ Treatment + cs(0 + Repetition | Block), data = dt)
    # If it failed to converge or has NaN in standard errors, discard it by assigning Inf
    if(!is.null(mod_comp_symm$sdr$pdHess) && !mod_comp_symm$sdr$pdHess) Inf else BIC(mod_comp_symm)
  }, error = function(e) Inf)
  
  # 3. Heterogeneous AR1 Model (via glmmTMB)
  bic_ar1 <- tryCatch({
    mod_ar1 <- glmmTMB(Response ~ Treatment + ar1(0 + Repetition | Block), data = dt)
    if(!is.null(mod_ar1$sdr$pdHess) && !mod_ar1$sdr$pdHess) Inf else BIC(mod_ar1)
  }, error = function(e) Inf)
  
  # 4. Unstructured Model with a robust fallback wrapper
  bic_unstr <- tryCatch({
    mod_unstr <- glmmTMB(
      Response ~ Treatment + us(0 + Repetition | Block), 
      data = dt,
      control = glmmTMBControl(optimizer = optim, optArgs = list(method = "BFGS"))
    )
    
    # Check if Hessian is valid. If it isn't, calculate forced BIC manually safely
    if (!is.null(mod_unstr$sdr$pdHess) && mod_unstr$sdr$pdHess) {
      BIC(mod_unstr)
    } else {
      # Safe manual extraction check
      neg_log_lik <- mod_unstr$fit$objective
      if (length(neg_log_lik) == 0 || is.na(neg_log_lik)) {
        Inf # If the math completely exploded, assign Infinity
      } else {
        k_params <- length(mod_unstr$fit$par)
        N_subjects <- length(unique(dt$Block)) # Dynamically count clusters (e.g., 20)
        -2 * (-neg_log_lik) + k_params * log(N_subjects)
      }
    }
  }, error = function(e) Inf)
  
  # Combine into a clean named vector
  bic_list <- c(Independent = bic_ind, CompoundSymmetric = bic_cs, AR1 = bic_ar1, Unstructured = bic_unstr)
  
  # Return a logical vector showing which one is the minimum
  return(bic_list == min(bic_list, na.rm = TRUE))
}

run_one_sim <- function(pars, trt_means, Sigma) {
    sim_data <- gen_data(pars, trt_means, Sigma)
    pick_best_model_fit(sim_data, cov_list)
}
```

```{r sim_params}
# Initialize simulation parameters
sim_params <- list(
    n_trt = 2,  # Treatments
    n_blk = 10, # Blocks
    n_rep = 5,  # Repetitions per Treatment/Block combo
    s2e = 10,   # Sigma^2_e
    s2b = 12,   # Sigma^2_b
    rho = 0.8,  # rho for AR1 covariance
    unstr_cov = matrix(c(
        15, 10, 12, 12, 2, 
        10, 18, 5, 13, 8, 
        12, 5, 20, 5, 3, 
        12, 13, 5, 15, 10, 
        2, 8, 3, 10, 12), nrow = 5, byrow = TRUE)
)

# List of the covariance functions with their names
cov_list <- list(
    Independent = gen_ind_cov, 
    CompoundSymmetric = gen_comp_symm_cov, 
    AR1 = gen_ar1_cov, 
    Unstructured = gen_unstr_cov
)
```

```{r run_sims}
#| warning: false
#| message: false


n_sims <- 100
trt_means <- c(50, 55)
covs <- gen_all_cov(sim_params)

output <- lapply(covs, \(x) {
  sims <- sapply(1:n_sims, \(sim) run_one_sim(sim_params, trt_means, x))
  colSums(t(sims))
})
final_dt <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, output))
rownames(final_dt) <- names(covs)
final_dt

gen_data(sim_params, trt_means, covs[[4]])

```
